{{Quote|An ambitious Warlord cast his lot with Dooku in exchange for control of all we have. Now he enslaves his own people to mine for the Separatists.|[[Adaroo]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars 7">[[The Clone Wars 7|''The Clone Wars'' 7]]</ref>}}
[[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] '''Unger Gout''' was a [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Born on [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]], he rose to power in the government and took over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], giving himself the title of "Warlord". By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he had [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] his species to mine [[Agrocite/Legends|Agrocite]] for [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. During the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]], he, along with [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], commanded the [[Battle droid/Legends|droid]] forces against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] troops, even kidnapping [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] and [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]] in the process, though they later escaped. Gout [[Death/Legends|died]] when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] detonated explosives on Gout's [[Agrocite cannon]]s, destroying them.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Unger Gout was born on [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] and quickly rose to power in the government. He eventually took over and made a deal with [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to enslave his own people to mine [[Agrocite/Legends|Agrocite]] for the Separatists on [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]], giving himself the title of Warlord.

===Battle of Khorm===
{{Main|Battle of Khorm/Legends}}
{{Quote|Bury them in ice!|Unger Gout giving an order during the battle|<ref name="The Clone Wars 7" />}}
Around 22 BBY,<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] launched a [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|full-scale assault]] on Khorm to halt the mining and production of Agroncite for the Separatist cause. Gout, though, had foreseen their attack and built a [[Weather-control station]] in order to create a planet-wide storm so air support could not be utilized by the Republic. During the initial stages of battle Gout managed to escape from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] on a [[Rail jet/Legends|rail jet]]. Later, reinforced by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], his droid forces managed to take [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]] prisoners. They later escaped, and Gout returned to the Agrocite mine, where he commanded his troops from a distance. Despite having multiple disagreements about the mine's security with Ventress, he reluctantly allowed her to plant explosives in the mine, in case the Jedi managed to penetrate the station's defenses. This ultimately proved the be his undoing, however, as the explosives were activated by Kit Fisto after he escorted the slaves to safety. The explosives reached Gout's [[Agrocite cannon]]s and his reserve of Agrocite, where he was hiding from the battle, and exploded. While trying to escape the facility, Gout was caught in the ensuing blast and was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Unger Gout was created for the [[2009]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic|''In Service of the Republic'']] storyline of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] comic series. The three issues of the storyline were written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]] and were illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]].
